thread:
Olivia Ops: Heads up team — final checklist for Thursday's virtual roundtable. Need to lock registration fields and Zoom recording profile by EOD.
Sam Growth: Quick Q — are we gating the replay behind a form? we did that last quarter and saw +12% MQLs but friction went up.
Priya Marketing: leaning toward soft gate: ask for company + role only, let replay link be emailed automatically. keeps conversion but reduces friction. @Marta Sales thoughts on lead quality?
Marta Sales: company + role + opt-in checkbox is fine. want a flag on HubSpot so we can prioritize SDRs and enterprise reps.
Olivia Ops: noted. registration page fields: name, email, company, role, opt-in (checkbox). also add "use-case" free text (optional).
Jamal Eng-Infra: Zoom settings — record separate audio tracks for panelists (we'll need alternate-language audio track), cloud recording + local backup for host. Also enable "Allow live streaming"? we will stream to RTMP fallback.
Priya Marketing: alt-audio is for the Mandarin interpreter. do we have SRT separate per language or embedded captions only?
Jamal Eng-Infra: Zoom produces one caption SRT by default. For interpreter audio we can do two things: 1) use Zoom language interpretation (creates alt audio channel) and we capture separate tracks; 2) ask interpreter to join as co-host and record separate track. I'd prefer Zoom interpretation channel so attendees can switch live.
Olivia Ops: if we do Zoom interpretation, recording exports separate audio tracks but SRTs remain single-language unless we transcribe separately post-event.
Sam Growth: we should plan post-event workflow: - auto-transcribe per language via Rev or otter -> generate localized SRTs - split recordings into speaker tracks -> create short clips for socials
Priya Marketing: agree. for replay gating flow: Zapier -> HubSpot mapping: registration -> create contact, add to list "Roundtable - registrants", if attended = add tag "attended" and send replay immediately to non-attendees after editing.
Olivia Ops: @Jamal can you paste the Zoom cloud recording settings we should use?
Jamal Eng-Infra: Sure: ```
Zoom Cloud Recording config:
- Record on host's cloud
- Record video + separate audio tracks for each participant
- Record active speaker + gallery
- Enable Interpretation channels (English, Mandarin)
- Auto-transcribe (English) -> export VTT
- Cloud recording retention: 30 days (temp)
``` 
Jamal Eng-Infra: Also set filename convention: RD-2026-0323-roundtable-<session>-<lang>-<track>.mp4
Priya Marketing: tagging rules: in HubSpot use property "ri_event_roundtable_2026" with values registered/attended/replay_sent. Also capture "use_case" as free text property.
Olivia Ops: Zapier mapping snippet (pseudo): ```
Trigger: Typeform -> New Entry
Action 1: Create/Update Contact (email, name, company, role)
Action 2: Add Contact to List "Roundtable - registrants"
Action 3: Create Engagement note with use_case field
Action 4: If Attended -> set property attended=true
``` 
Marta Sales: For MQL routing: if company size >= 100 and role in ["VP","Head","Director"] -> assign to Enterprise SDR queue. HubSpot list filter will handle it.
Sam Growth: Messaging iteration: we'll A/B test two post-event subject lines for replay: "Replay + key takeaways" vs "Recording + short clips". send to non-attendees 24h after event.
Priya Marketing: Social posts: 1) announcement live on LinkedIn + X during roundtable, 2) 30s clips 48h after. Need edit owners for clips: @Ava PM to coordinate edits with vendor.
Ava PM: confirmed. I'll assign edit tasks in Notion and share S3 path. timeline: raw files ingested by EOD Fri, edits done by Tue.
Olivia Ops: final ops checklist for recording day: mic checks 30m prior, interpreter join 20m prior, start cloud recording manually, start local recording, enable interpretation channel, note house-keeping message at start for attendees about recordings and data use.
Priya Marketing: copy for registration confirmation email: "Thanks for registering — you'll get the Zoom link and a replay if you can't make it. We'll also share curated clips after the event." Short + clear.
Sam Growth: can we add UTM params to registration links for benchmark posts? utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=roundtable_march
Olivia Ops: yes — track source in hidden field on Typeform.
Jamal Eng-Infra: post-event file split/actions: 1) export each audio track + master video, 2) generate transcripts per track, 3) create captions (SRT) per language, 4) create 3 short topic clips (00:45-01:30) marked by timestamps, upload to S3, tag in Notion.
Priya Marketing: owners recap: Registration page & Zap: Olivia Ops. HubSpot mapping & lists: Priya. Recording config & filename conventions: Jamal. Clip edits & social copy: Ava. SDR routing: Marta. Send replay cadence: Sam.
Olivia Ops: perfect. I'll push changes to Typeform tonight and share test link. please test before midnight. :thumbsup:
ZoomBot: Reminder — scheduled cloud recording will start automatically if host joins. Use /start_recording to manually kick off.
Sam Growth: will test RSVP -> Zapier -> HubSpot flow tomorrow AM. Thanks team.
Priya Marketing: thanks all — will iterate messaging after we see registration copy tests. :party-parrot:
